website.quote: The CLEO Collaboration operated the CLEO high-energy physics detector for nearly thirty years, from 1979 to 2008

summary.plain: The Cornell-based collaboration that built and ran CLEO at CESR. It began with groups from Cornell, Harvard, Rochester and Syracuse and grew to over 200 authors by 1996, with groups from across North America.
summary.technical: CLEO Collaboration: began as the South Area Experiment study group of Cornell, Harvard, Rochester and Syracuse (1975); first CLEO paper 73 authors from 8 institutions (1980); peak 212 authors on CLEO papers in 1996; membership then declined as members left for BaBar and Belle (Berkelman).
